confirmed_before: Date.parse truncates submillisecond precision; three one-microsecond-older checks were accepted. Calendar normalization, excess fraction precision and a source without timezone were also accepted.
corrected_rules: Both clocks require explicit timezone and at most six fractional digits.
Calendar and clock fields must round-trip exactly without normalization.
UTC offset is applied to integer seconds; full microseconds compared as BigInt.
Equal or later instants accepted, including equivalent offsets and crossing midnight.
Original payload, recovery UUID, receipt and display strings remain unchanged.
